question: With reference to the GOBARdhan Scheme launched in October 2026, consider the following statements: 1. It has an outlay of ₹23,731 crore spread over ten years from FY 2026-27. 2. It envisages CBG blending obligations of 3% in FY 2026-27 rising to 5% from FY 2028-29. 3. It is implemented by the Ministry of Jal Shakti through the Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen). Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Outlay ₹23,731 crore over FY27–FY36 and the 3%→4%→5% blending obligation are correct; the scheme is led by the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, not Jal Shakti.
subject: Economy

question: The 'People's Plan Campaign 2026-27 — Sabki Yojana, Sabka Vikas' was launched through special Gram Sabhas on 2 October 2026. Consider the following statements: 1. It is led by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj. 2. Gram Panchayats prepare their development plans and upload them on the e-GramSwaraj portal. 3. The plans are uploaded on the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan portal. Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: The campaign is run by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj and plans are uploaded on e-GramSwaraj; the PM Gati Shakti portal is not part of it.
subject: Polity & Governance

question: The ICAR–FCI MoU of October 2026 on foodgrain storage aims to trial alternatives to chemical fumigation. Consider the following statements: 1. Phase I includes nitrogen fumigation of wheat stored in metal silos. 2. The trials seek to reduce reliance on aluminium phosphide and malathion, to which storage pests have developed resistance. 3. A combination of carbon dioxide and phosphine is among the methods to be trialled for bagged grain. Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three are part of the ICAR–FCI Phase I trial design and objective (two-year pilot, then a one-year multi-location phase).
subject: Agriculture
